seoul.title: Seoul
seoul.subtitle: The Capital Where Tradition Meets Modernity
seoul.description: Seoul is a city where 600 years of royal palace history meets cutting-edge skyscrapers. Experience the Joseon Dynasty at Gyeongbokgung and Changdeokgung Palaces, and enjoy shopping and dining in Myeongdong and Gangnam.

attractions.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
attractions.desc: The main royal palace of the Joseon Dynasty

attractions.name: Changdeokgung Palace
attractions.desc: UNESCO World Heritage Site with Secret Garden

attractions.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
attractions.desc: Traditional Korean houses in beautiful alleys

busan.title: Busan
busan.subtitle: Korea's Second City of Sea and Mountains
busan.description: Busan is a vibrant port city with beautiful coastlines. Enjoy romantic night views at Haeundae Beach, The Bay 101, and Gwangalli Beach.

attractions.name: The Bay 101
attractions.desc: Night view hotspot in Marine City

attractions.name: Gwangan Bridge
attractions.desc: Busan's iconic bridge with beautiful night views

attractions.name: Hot Place
attractions.desc: Youth district with shopping and dining

gyeongju.title: Gyeongju
gyeongju.subtitle: Millennium Capital, City of Silla History
gyeongju.description: Gyeongju preserves the thousand-year history and culture of the Silla Kingdom. Visit UNESCO World Heritage sites including Bulguksa Temple, Seokguram Grotto, and Daereungwon.

attractions.name: Seokguram Grotto
attractions.desc: UNESCO World Heritage stone cave temple

attractions.name: Daereungwon
attractions.desc: Ancient tomb complex of Silla royalty

danyang.title: Danyang
danyang.subtitle: Scenic Beauty of Namhan River and Majestic Mountains
danyang.description: Danyang is famous for Dodamsambong, Guinsa Temple, and Danyang River Walk. Enjoy paragliding and rafting activities.

attractions.name: Dodamsambong
attractions.desc: Three peaks in the Namhan River

chuncheon.title: Chuncheon
chuncheon.subtitle: Romantic City of Lakes and Islands
chuncheon.description: Chuncheon is famous for the beautiful scenery of Uiamho Lake, Nami Island, and Soyang River. Enjoy delicious dakgalbi and makguksu.

attractions.name: Nami Island
attractions.desc: Beautiful island, famous drama filming location

incheon.title: Incheon
incheon.subtitle: International Airport City of Diverse Cultures
incheon.description: Incheon offers diverse attractions including Chinatown, Songdo, and Ganghwa Island. It serves as the gateway to Korea through Incheon International Airport.

paju.title: Paju
paju.subtitle: Border City Where Peace and Art Coexist
paju.description: Paju features Imjingak, Provence, and Heyri Art Village. View North Korea from the DMZ Peace Trail.

attractions.name: Imjingak
attractions.desc: Bell of Peace and Freedom Bridge

ganghwa.title: Ganghwa
ganghwa.subtitle: Beautiful Island of History and Nature
ganghwa.description: Ganghwa Island features historical sites like dolmens and Ganghwaseong Fortress, along with beautiful natural scenery. Popular for mudflat experiences and luge.

jeonju.title: Jeonju
jeonju.subtitle: Center of Korean Traditional Culture
jeonju.description: Jeonju represents Korean traditional culture with Hanok Village, Bibimbap, and Hanji paper. Jeonju Hanok Village with over 800 hanoks is a must-visit destination in Korea.

attractions.name: Gyeonggijeon
attractions.desc: Shrine housing portrait of King Taejo

attractions.name: Jeonju Bibimbap
attractions.desc: One of Korea's top three bibimbap
